privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p1: Açaíwave+ respects your privacy. We are an online catalog created for informational and portfolio purposes only, displaying public data about movies and series. We do not host videos, do not stream content, and do not charge any fees.
privacy.section1-text: We collect only the minimum necessary for operation:

section1-list.item2: Basic browsing data (cookies and anonymous metrics);
section1-list.item3: Information submitted voluntarily, such as user registration.

privacy.section2-text: Açaíwave+ may display embedded videos from external platforms such as YouTube or similar services. These videos are not hosted by us — playback happens directly on the source platform. Any data collection during playback is the responsibility of the platform providing the video.
privacy.section3-text: We use data only to improve the experience, adjust preferences, and keep the platform running smoothly.
privacy.section4-text: We do not sell data. Only analytics services may have limited, anonymized access to understand platform usage.
privacy.section5-text: We take measures to keep your data protected, within the limits of a personal, non-commercial project.
privacy.section6-text: You can request access, modification, or deletion of your registration data.

terms.title: Açaíwave+ Terms of Use
terms.p1: These terms explain how Açaíwave+ should be used. By continuing to browse, you agree to these conditions.
terms.section1-text: Açaíwave+ is an informative catalog created as a personal project. We are not a streaming service, do not host videos, and do not provide copyrighted content.
terms.section2-text: The information displayed is obtained from public databases, such as TMDb. All rights belong to the original owners.
terms.section3-text: Embedded videos shown on Açaíwave+ (trailers, previews, promotional materials, etc.) are played directly from external platforms. Açaíwave+ does not control ads, cookies, or recommendations shown by those platforms.
terms.section4-text: Use of the platform is completely free. There are no paid plans, subscriptions, or charges.

section5-list.item3: trying to modify or damage the site.

terms.section6-text: Açaíwave+ is not responsible for external services such as TMDb or YouTube.

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.p1: This policy explains how Açaíwave+ uses cookies to improve navigation and remember basic preferences.
cookies.section1-text: Cookies are small files used to enhance the user experience.
cookies.section3-text: Videos displayed on Açaíwave+ are loaded from services like YouTube. Those services may use their own cookies, and Açaíwave+ does not control or access that data.
